program.subject: Surprise
program.blurb: A short, timed day from a different subject every day, all twenty before any repeats.
program.about: Twenty subjects, one short day each, before any comes back. Each comes as a circuit, an EMOM, an AMRAP or a Tabata, from chest and back to boxing, HIIT, Pilates and balance. About twenty minutes and done. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Every day a different subject · timed formats, short
